title: An Artist Who Turns Pumpkins into Spooky Faces
summary:
Ray Villafane does not just carve pumpkins. He turns them into amazing 3-D sculptures with spooky faces.

Villafane grew up in New York. He became an art teacher in Michigan. One Halloween, he carved a pumpkin so cool that his students asked for more. Soon, hotels and restaurants wanted them too.

Later, he made toys for Marvel Comics, including a Wolverine figure from X-Men. He also worked for DC Comics. But he loved pumpkins most, so in 2010 he began carving them full-time. He has won Food Network's Outrageous Pumpkins contest two times.

This Halloween, more than 40 of his pumpkin characters are on show in Gilbert, Arizona, until November 1, 2026. On October 24, people can watch him carve one live.

His tip: pick a big, heavy pumpkin. It does not have to be round. Funny shapes give it character!
why_it_matters: His story shows that a hobby you love can grow into something amazing.

keywords.explanation: Sculptures are pieces of art shaped or carved into 3-D forms.
3-D means having height, width and depth, not flat.
